_doc: Special releases: the only way a 90-600 second upload may be published.
K (2026-11-26): that duration band is the channel's worst bucket (0.07
views/day), so an MV in it must be a deliberate exception - at most two per
quarter, each with a stated reason and a companion <=60s hook cut that
points at the volume. ops/clip_standard.duration_verdict() reads this file
and fails closed: a missing or empty list allows nothing.
